label: Figure 7.8: Calculating consumer and producer surplus
alt: Demand and supply for smartwatches crossing at $60 and 1,000 units, with consumer surplus (above $60) and producer surplus (below $60) shaded.
caption: Demand runs from $120 to 2,000 units and supply starts at $20; they meet at the equilibrium of $60 and 1,000 smartwatches. Consumer surplus is the triangle above $60: ½ × 1,000 × ($120 − $60) = $30,000. Producer surplus is the triangle below $60: ½ × 1,000 × ($60 − $20) = $20,000.
